image_description: A small brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet or similar satyrid, perched on a green blade of grass. The wings are held closed, displaying a ventral pattern of brown scales with distinct rows of eyespots (ocelli) featuring orange rings and white centers. The background consists of blurred green vegetation and yellow flowers. There is visible text in the bottom right corner.
